## Training programmes

- Management Development Programmes (MDPs) on data and business analytics for organisations including PwC, the Reserve Bank of India and GMR.
- Faculty Development Programmes (FDPs) for faculty and research scholars from IITs, IIMs, IMT and other leading institutes.

For customised training programmes or consultancy projects, write to [aritra.pan@mse.ac.in](mailto:aritra.pan@mse.ac.in).
